summary: All eight P12a carriers (GitblitMCPServer as canary, then YouTrackMCPServer, Ginbov, NewsFilter, ScanToPdfServer, GitblitMCPSupportPlugin, Webathome, MyDownloadsServer) run the aac-tools toolchain's arch-validate in their architecture Jenkinsfile and local gate, their copies are deleted, and each is pushed and done: app builds green, every Application they pin Healthy at the pin, and their own AaC build green. The ScanToPdf and MyDownloads packager repos, whose environments host the server and client repos, now declare aac-tools. They were pushed and are done too (close-out N6). The environment restarts are the operator's (close-out A5).
